name: Umami
tagline: Umami is a simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.
description: Umami is a simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: App secret
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# List of services that this application uses
services:
  # Main service for the Umami application
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:postgresql-latest@sha256:e69d1a7932e9dab0fc523edc7be1f3a53f3c261f57856fc2167ae74a8fc022e8 # Docker image for the Umami app
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000" # Port mapping: host:container
    environment: # Environment variables for the service
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://umami:umami@db:5432/umami
      DATABASE_TYPE: postgresql
      APP_SECRET: ${SECRET_APP_SECRET}
    depends_on: # Dependency of this service
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: always # Restart policy
  # Database service for the Umami application
  db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine@sha256:3d0f7584ed7d04e27fa050d6683a74746608faf21f202be78460d679cc56461f # Docker image for the PostgreSQL database
    environment: # Environment variables for the service
      POSTGRES_DB: umami
      POSTGRES_USER: umami
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: umami
    volumes: # Volumes for data persistence
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: always # Restart policy
    healthcheck: # Health check configuration
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
